transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ___; what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I guess people are having a hard time understanding me lately. 

When I'm writing my artist statements or client notes, or even just talking in meetings, I've started jumping around a lot. I'll go from talking about textures to budgets, and then into... like, secret meanings. People just keep telling me they can’t follow what I’m trying to explain, so I figured I should come in and talk to someone.
When you’re talking, do your thoughts ever feel so jumbled that other people can’t follow what you mean?

Yeah, exactly. That's... pretty much what I was just trying to explain. It happens when I talk, and even when I write. 

Like I said, I'll be doing my client notes or sitting in a meeting, and I just start jumping from the physical textures of a piece, straight to the budget, and then into these secret meanings. It makes sense in my head, but people keep pointing out that it's just too jumbled for them to follow.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t?

Yeah, I have. Um, mostly when I'm alone in the studio. Sometimes I hear a woman quietly commenting from behind the storage shelves. Or I'll smell hot metal near an unfinished piece. It feels completely real when it's happening, but... then I'll go look behind the shelves or check the area, and there’s just nothing there.
Have you had any period of at least one week when you felt unusually energetic or irritable with a much decreased need for sleep?

Yeah, I do. For stretches of time, I just feel... lit up, I guess. Almost unstoppable. It's like every idea I have is brilliant and I just have to keep working. 

But then, on the flip side, I can get really irritable. Like, if a collaborator makes even a small comment about a piece, I can snap at them in a way that feels... well, way bigger than the situation actually calls for.
Do the voices, smells, or other unusual experiences ever happen when your mood feels completely normal?

Yeah, actually. There was this one month, maybe a little while ago, where things were pretty quiet. I was sleeping normally again, getting a full night's rest, and I didn't have that unstoppable, lit-up feeling at all. My mood was just... regular. 

But even then, for a few weeks during that time, I was still hearing that woman's voice commenting from behind the storage shelves. And I was still seeing those hidden warnings in my ordinary studio materials, like the clay or the wire. So, yeah, it definitely still happens even when I'm feeling completely normal.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when the voices or other unusual experiences were present even though you were not having any manic or depressed episode at all?

Yeah, like I was just saying... there was that quieter month. I wasn't having any of those extreme highs or lows. I was sleeping fine, not feeling unstoppable at all. But for at least a couple of weeks during that time, I was definitely still hearing those comments from the shelves and seeing those warnings in my studio materials. So, yes, it lasted for over two weeks even when my mood was completely fine.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when the voices or other unusual experiences were present while your mood was not manic or depressed?

Yeah, I think I just mentioned that. There was that month where things were pretty calm. I was sleeping normally, not feeling all revved up or unstoppable. But for a few weeks during that time, I was still hearing the voice coming from behind the shelves, and I was still seeing those warnings in my clay and wire. So, yes, it definitely lasted for at least two weeks while my mood was normal.
Have you ever had any voices, visions, or other unusual experiences only when your mood was very high or very low, and not at other times?

Well, no, not *only* then, since I just mentioned having them when my mood was normal. But I definitely did have them when I was really high, too. During those times when I was super charged up about my art, barely sleeping, and just taking on way too many projects... I was absolutely convinced that paint stains and random phrases in my emails were sending me specific instructions. And I'd hear that woman's voice commenting on me in the studio then, too. So it happened during the highs, but not *only* during the highs.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least one week when you felt unusually elevated or irritable and much more energetic than usual?

Yes, definitely. There are these stretches where I just feel completely lit up. It's like I'm almost unstoppable, and every single idea I have for a project feels brilliant. I get so much energy. But during those same times, if a collaborator or someone makes even a small comment, I can just snap. I get really irritable, and my reaction is way bigger than the situation actually calls for. So yeah, I've had periods like that for a week or more.
Have there ever been times when you were hearing voices, seeing things, or strongly believing unusual messages were real even though you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Yeah, I think that's kind of what I was mentioning earlier. There was a quieter month where my mood was totally fine—I was sleeping more normally and I wasn't feeling unstoppable or down at all. But even during that time, for several weeks, I still kept hearing those comments coming from behind the shelves, and I was still reading hidden warnings into ordinary studio materials. So, yes, it definitely happened even when I didn't have any mood symptoms.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt clearly depressed or lost interest or pleasure in things nearly every day?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I've never really had a time where I felt super depressed or just stopped caring about my art or everyday things for two weeks straight. It's usually either the really high energy periods I talked about, or just feeling normal. So, no, I haven't really experienced that.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing or believing unusual things while your mood was completely normal?

Yeah, like I said a minute ago, that definitely happened. There was that one month where things were actually pretty quiet for me mood-wise. I was sleeping fine, not feeling super charged up or anything. But for a few weeks during that time, I was still hearing those voices making comments from behind the shelves in my studio. And I was still seeing those hidden warnings in my supplies. So yeah, it lasted for a few weeks even though my mood was totally normal.
